en.t: In fact, that was not the case.

units.source_text: 在我们的眼皮下，隔着马路立着一座天授庵。

en.t: Right below our eyes, across the road, stood Tenshu-an.

units.source_text: 从简朴地种着许多矮树的寂静的庭院，穿过用四角石角接角地铺成的一条小曲径，通到了敞开着拉门的宽阔的客厅。

en.t: From a quiet garden simply planted with many low shrubs, a narrow winding path paved corner to corner with square stones led to a spacious reception room whose sliding doors stood open.

units.source_text: 可以清楚地看见客厅里的壁龛和百宝架。

en.t: The alcove and staggered shelves in the reception room could be seen clearly.

units.source_text: 这里似乎经常用作举办供神佛的献茶，以及供人租用举办茶会，所以铺着鲜艳的绯红色地毯。

en.t: It seemed that the place was often used for offering tea to the gods and Buddhas, as well as rented out for tea gatherings, so a vivid scarlet carpet had been laid there.

units.source_text: 室内跪坐着一个年轻的女子。

en.t: A young woman was kneeling inside the room.

units.source_text: 映入我眼帘的，就是这些东西。

en.t: These were the things that came into my view.
